literal_meaning: গর গর শব্দ (কুকুরের গর্জনের অনুকরণমূলক ধ্বনি)
figurative_meaning_en: An onomatopoeic reduplicated word expressing the feeling of anger
example_sentences_in_bangla: অচেনা লোক দেখে কুকুরটা গরগর করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The dog is growling at the stranger.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression mimicking a dog's growl, often used to denote anger in both animals and humans in informal contexts.
